description.default: Privacy mode for SiYuan: hide names in the file tree, tabs, doc title, window title and headings (h1-h6); hide the current document's body block-by-block (tables cell-by-cell) or by selection, using a rounded bar / blank / custom text / random text; two shortcuts (editable / read-only); optional password-to-unlock; auto-enter after N idle minutes (optionally read-only); auto-collapse the file tree after N minutes.
description.zh_CN: 思源隐私模式：遮盖文档树/页签/文档标题/窗口标题/标题（h1-h6）；逐条遮盖当前文档正文（表格逐格）或按块选择，形式支持「圆角矩形条 / 空白 / 指定文字 / 随机文字」。两个快捷键（可编辑 / 不可编辑）、密码解锁、空闲自动进入（可选不可编辑）、N 分钟后自动收起文档树。
